data.narrative:
Mbodi AI is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Xavier Chi and Sebastian Peralta. The company has raised $4.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public company in the sector.

Given the absence of sufficient proximate comparables at the same stage and valuation tier, peer-median analysis was not applicable. The stage-progression method was therefore the primary valuation lever. Using total capital raised ($4.4M) as a base value proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $11M. This method assumes Mbodi AI's capital efficiency and development velocity are in line with median cohort performance.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $9M to $13M, with a midpoint of $11M. The primary uncertainty stems from the narrow methodological foundation—reliance on a single applicable approach reflects limited public disclosure among early-stage robotics companies and the absence of directly comparable financing events. Investors should weight this valuation against direct market signals, including recent investor interest and product-market validation metrics not captured in this quantitative framework.
